issue.title: ledger-tools 'Live Preview performance stays bounded on a large child block' 5 s wall-clock gate flakes under full npm test load

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by bob-cli-e8.5 note #1 (live mention index phase, 2026-10-29): during a full bob-plugins `npm test`, "Live Preview performance stays bounded on a large child block" in scripts/test-ledger-tools-freshness-mark-surfaces.cjs failed its wall-clock bound, then passed when the file ran alone on the same tree. The e8.5 agent did not cause it (it touched relation-index fragments only).

Independent observation by the bob-cli-e8 land agent (2026-10-30, bob-plugins 8dbcbea plus a one-line nav fix): the same test PASSED under the full `npm test` (4,384 tests) but took 3,237 ms against its `elapsed < 5000` bound (line ~939), so the margin under full-suite parallel load is thin. Fail rate: 1 failure in 2 observed full-suite runs; 0 failures observed serially. The bound is a raw Date.now() wall-clock gate, which is load-sensitive in the same way as the closed capture_related 500 ms gates (bob-cli-bo, bob-cli-ca).
